name: Biogas reforming to hydrogen
principle: Upgraded biogas or biomethane is steam-reformed like natural gas to make hydrogen, or used as the hydrogen feed for products such as ammonia. The hydrogen is renewable by feedstock, and CO2 capture can make it carbon-negative. In Cubatão, Brazil, Yara started ammonia production from biomethane, with a goal of 6 to 7 ktpa.
